interpretation_limits: Independent repeat count is n=3 training seeds per method, not 2304 episodes.
Seeds 3042/4042 were used in the earlier DR study; this is fixed-scene reevaluation, not an entirely new unseen test set.
Dyna adds model fitting and imagined optimization; matching real-transition budgets does not match compute budgets.
CUDA checkpoint integrity checks are recorded evaluator evidence, corroborated against training metadata; this audit did not load models or run inference.
Target-motion RMS and 50 Hz joint-velocity-difference acceleration combine normal gait and unwanted motion; they do not isolate high-frequency jitter.
Local within-range simulation results do not establish official course scores, out-of-range robustness or hardware behavior.
